scope: N06 serial Fabric/executor connection; not concurrent H417 synchronization or public API
pipeline: publish data, return epoch-tagged ticket, explicit hint delivery, explicit normal opportunity, bounded pop/take/read/release
notification: adapter hints cleared before probe; retained after success or contention; distinct from Fabric sticky notice bits
gate_feedback: serialized call-local entered flag distinguishes busy from empty; not safe for concurrent use
recovery: explicit worker offline and DMA quiet declarations before attest/restart; queued executor hints may survive; stale leases rechecked by epoch
negative_control: message-only late clear loses notification published after empty probe
